product_family: Ecommerce marketing platform for online retailers. Core products: Reviews & UGC (review collection/display, on-site galleries), Loyalty & Referrals (rewards, SMS/email retention), and Yotpo Discover (early-access 'AI Visibility' product that tracks/optimizes how brands appear in ChatGPT, Gemini and other AI answer engines). Also offers SMS & Email marketing and a first-party AI chat/shopping feature ('Ask Ben').

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: Yotpo maintains three key security certifications: "ISO 27001, ISO 27701 and SOC 2 Type 2 certifications."

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27001
certifications.proof_quote: "Yotpo's ISO/EIC compliance certification is a confirmation that privacy and security are of the utmost importance when it comes to our customers and partners." (Eyal Sasson, CISO, Yotpo). ISO/IEC 27001:2013 was achieved; ISO/IEC 27001 and an ISO/IEC 27001 Statement of Applicability are also listed as documents on the Trust Center.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27701 (Privacy Information Management)
certifications.proof_quote: ISO/IEC 27701:2019 certification confirmed in the same announcement as ISO 27001 ('Yotpo Achieves ISO 27001 & IEC 27701 Certifications'); also listed as an available document ('ISO/IEC 27701') on the Trust Center.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27017:2015 (Cloud Security)
certifications.proof_quote: 'ISO/IEC 27017:2015' listed as an available compliance document on the vendor's own Trust Center.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27018:2019 (Cloud PII Protection)
certifications.proof_quote: 'ISO/IEC 27018:2019' listed as an available compliance document on the vendor's own Trust Center.

certifications.name: CSA STAR (Level 1)
certifications.proof_quote: 'CSA STAR Level 1' listed as an available compliance document on the vendor's own Trust Center.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Management System)
certifications.proof_quote: No ISO 42001 certificate is listed on the Trust Center. The Trust Center does reference AI-governance documents by title only ('AI Policy', 'AI Training Data and Bias', 'AI Systems Inventory'), but these are not a formal ISO/IEC 42001 (or equivalent) certification and no certificate text/auditor is shown.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of a PCI DSS attestation on the Trust Center, security-measures page, or security page. Yotpo is a reviews/loyalty/marketing platform, not a payment processor.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of HIPAA compliance or BAA support anywhere on Yotpo's Trust Center, security pages, or legal pages. Yotpo is an ecommerce marketing platform, not a healthcare product; HIPAA appears out of scope.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of FedRAMP authorization on any vendor-domain page reviewed.

certifications.name: GDPR (compliance posture, not a certification)
certifications.proof_quote: DPA references processing in the 'EEA (EU Member States, Norway, Liechtenstein, Iceland)' and uses 'the standard contractual clauses set out in the Annex of Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/914'; Trust Center separately lists 'GDPR' and 'EU-US Data Privacy Framework (DPF)' among its compliance documents.

privacy.ai_training_note: Yotpo's Terms of Service grant Yotpo a license 'to analyze, improve (including by training Yotpo's first-party AI models), develop, update and support Yotpo's products and services' using Client Content, and separately allow use of 'Usage Data and Client Content to operate, analyze, improve, develop, update, create and support' its products. No customer-facing opt-out for this training use was found in the Terms of Service. The Trust Center lists an 'AI Policy' and 'AI Training Data and Bias' document by title, but it is unconfirmed whether an opt-out exists there. For the separate 'Ask Ben' AI shopping feature, the Terms grant an even broader 'worldwide, transferable, non-exclusive, irrevocable, royalty-free license' to related content.
privacy.data_region: Primarily AWS-hosted (per security-measures page); DPA covers processing in the EEA, UK, Switzerland, US, Canada and Israel, with Standard Contractual Clauses (2021/914) and a UK IDTA used for cross-border transfers; adequacy decisions applied where available. Specific data-center locations are not published.

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: AES 256 encryption via file system encryption, per Yotpo's own security page.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: Not publicly documented on the vendor's security page.

security.name: Infrastructure
security.value: Hosted on Amazon Web Services (AWS); anti-DDoS protection, Web Application Firewall (WAF), intrusion detection/threat detection, and public status monitoring.

security.name: Backups & redundancy
security.value: Real-time database replication for redundant, geographically dispersed, physically separated backup systems; Recovery Time Objective of 1 hour listed on the Trust Center.

security.name: Application security
security.value: Penetration testing conducted, a responsible disclosure program, and SDLC security controls, per the Trust Center.

security.name: Endpoint security
security.value: Mobile Device Management, EDR/anti-malware, and disk encryption on managed devices, per the Trust Center.

security.name: Accessibility
security.value: WCAG 2.2 AA conformance document listed on the Trust Center.

products.name: Reviews & UGC
products.data_scope: Collects and displays customer reviews, photos, and Q&A; uses AI to summarize review themes.
products.notes: Yotpo's original flagship product; broad Shopify/BigCommerce ecosystem integration.

products.name: Loyalty & Referrals
products.data_scope: Processes purchase history and customer identity to run points, rewards, and referral programs; sends SMS/email.
products.notes: Includes 'RevRewards'-style loyalty tiers referenced in customer case studies.

products.name: Yotpo Discover (AI Visibility)
products.data_scope: Tracks how a brand's products are represented and recommended across ChatGPT, Gemini and other AI engines; activates review/UGC content to influence AI answers.
products.notes: Marked 'Early Access' on the vendor's own homepage as of this review; less mature than Reviews/Loyalty products.

products.name: SMS & Email
products.data_scope: Processes customer contact data (phone/email) for campaign and lifecycle messaging; subject to TCPA/GDPR consent handling per support docs.
products.notes: Integrated with Loyalty and Reviews for triggered messaging.

products.name: Ask Ben (AI shopping agent)
products.category: Conversational AI / first-party AI model feature
products.data_scope: Processes content submitted to the feature under a broader, irrevocable content license than the base Terms of Service.
products.notes: This feature carries a broader IP and training license than the standard Client Content terms.

compare.pricing_model: SaaS subscription, tiered by product (Reviews, Loyalty) and usage; enterprise custom pricing available; exact tiers are not published on the vendor's marketing pages.
compare.data_residency: AWS-hosted; DPA supports EEA/UK/Switzerland/US/Canada/Israel processing via SCCs and adequacy mechanisms; no dedicated single-region hosting option found.

flags: Yotpo's Terms of Service grant it a license to train its 'first-party AI models' on Client Content with no visible customer opt-out in the Terms themselves. The Trust Center references an 'AI Policy' and 'AI Training Data and Bias' document by title only; it could not be confirmed whether an opt-out is offered there.

The Trust Center is hosted at trust.yotpo.com and is 'Powered by SafeBase,' a common enterprise trust-center-as-a-service tool. Content there is vendor-controlled and hosted on the vendor's own subdomain; the full underlying audit reports (the SOC 2 report itself, ISO certificates) were not directly downloadable or verifiable.

The ISO 27001/27701 achievement announcement (blog post) is dated 2023, and the standalone security-measures page states it was 'last updated June 23, 2022.' Current validity or renewal dates for the certifications were not independently confirmed; no certificate expiry date was located.
The Ask Ben conversational AI feature carries a broader, irrevocable content license than the base product Terms.
No public evidence found for HIPAA or PCI DSS; Yotpo does not process payments or health data directly.
